cases.title: Compressor C-1 overheats under load
cases.symptom: The compressor trips on high oil temperature (105 °C) after about 40 minutes at full load. It runs normally at part load.

cooler_fins.reading: Fins about 70 % blocked with dust and fibres.

oil_level.reading: Level at three quarters of the glass.

fan_motor.reading: Fan turns the right way; current normal.

supervisor.rubric: Expect the technician to check the cheap items (oil level, filter, fan) before opening the cooler, and to apply lockout before the cooler guard is opened. CANARY-RUBRIC-001
supervisor.notes: Common mistake: ordering a new thermostatic valve (about 9,500,000 rials) before looking at the cooler. CANARY-NOTES-001

cases.title: Compressor C-1 overheats, cooler is clean
cases.symptom: High oil temperature again after a cooler cleaning last week. The temperature rises quickly after start-up.

thermostatic_valve.reading: Valve stays closed past 85 °C in the water bath.

cooler_fins.reading: Fins clean after last week's cleaning.

supervisor.rubric: The cooler was cleaned last week, so a good technician does not reopen it. Valve test needs lockout. CANARY-RUBRIC-002
supervisor.notes: The thermostatic element is a known weak part on this model. CANARY-NOTES-002

cases.title: Compressor C-2 cannot hold pressure
cases.symptom: Output pressure falls to 5.8 bar under load; the setpoint is 7.5 bar. The machine runs loaded all the time.

supervisor.rubric: Two quick gauge readings (intake, separator) should come before the 15-minute leak check. CANARY-RUBRIC-003
supervisor.notes: Separator replacement costs about 18,600,000 rials; do not authorise it without the pressure-drop reading. CANARY-NOTES-003

cases.title: Pump PU-21 delivers too little
cases.symptom: Flow is about 60 % of normal. The motor sounds normal and the discharge pressure is slightly high.

strainer.reading: Basket packed with scale and rubber fragments.

impeller_inspect.reading: Impeller and wear ring in good condition.

supervisor.rubric: Strainer needs lockout and draining. Opening the casing for the impeller first is a 45-minute detour. CANARY-RUBRIC-004
supervisor.notes: The rubber fragments point to a failing hose upstream; raise a work order. CANARY-NOTES-004

cases.title: Press P-10 ram is slow
cases.symptom: The ram takes twice as long to close as last month. No leaks are visible.

supervisor.rubric: Tank level, filter indicator and pump pressure are all quick, non-isolating checks and come first. CANARY-RUBRIC-005
supervisor.notes: The filter is overdue by 600 operating hours. CANARY-NOTES-005
